title: Week 11 — 80s Synth-Pop
goal: Four chord shapes, one repeating 1980s-inspired pop rhythm, and creative playing over a drumbeat.

source.description: User-supplied verified historical material, Version 1.4 brief

originalText:
# Week 11 — 80s Synth-Pop

November 8, 2026
Duration: 25 minutes.
Tempo: 90 BPM.
Instrument: Roland GO:KEYS 3.
Goal: Four chord shapes, one repeating 1980s-inspired pop rhythm, and creative playing over a drumbeat.

## Warm-up — 3 minutes

LH: — | RH: C → D → E → G → A
LH: — | RH: A → G → E → D → C
LH: — | RH: E → G → A → G
LH: — | RH: E → D → C

Play slowly, then experiment with making the beginning louder and ending softer.

## Chord shapes — 6 minutes

1. LH: C + G | RH: G + C + E
2. LH: G + D | RH: G + B + D
3. LH: A + E | RH: A + C + E
4. LH: F + C | RH: A + C + F

Play 1 → 2 → 3 → 4, then repeat.

Initially, press both hands together on beat 1, hold through beat 4, and release just before the next beat 1.

## Rhythm — 5 minutes

Count: 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &

For each chord:
1: Press LH and RH together.
First &: Release RH while holding LH.
2: Continue holding LH.
& after 2: Press RH chord again.
3: Release RH.
& after 3: Continue holding LH.
4: Press RH chord again.
Final &: Release everything.

Repeat the same rhythm for the next chord.

## Drumbeat — 8 minutes

Beat-only track:
90 BPM — Simple Straight Beat, Lumbeat
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9U3RG0JU4Ds

First four minutes: Play the four full chord shapes.

Next four minutes: Retain the first two RH chord hits, but replace the hit on beat 4 with a single note.

1. LH: C + G (held) | RH: E
2. LH: G + D (held) | RH: D
3. LH: A + E (held) | RH: E
4. LH: F + C (held) | RH: F

This introduces a small melody above the repeating harmony.

## Optional GO:KEYS 3 sound experiment — 3 minutes

Use Dual mode.

UPPER: 80s FM EP
LOWER: JP8 Strings 1

The original lesson instructs the player to select Dual using the split/dual control, select the UPPER and LOWER sounds, and reduce LOWER Level if the strings are too prominent.

## Listening inspiration

Time After Time — Cyndi Lauper
https://music.apple.com/us/song/400603695
Listen to the restrained keyboard sounds beneath the vocals.

Everybody Wants to Rule the World — Tears for Fears
https://music.apple.com/us/song/1440813515
Listen for the bright keyboard textures, bass movement, and interacting musical layers.

These listening selections illustrate the general feel, not the exact lesson chords.
